text:
alex: Quick sync — I'm drafting release notes for the upcoming docs site push (adaptive routing + KV cache persistence). Need: 1) final feature blurb, 2) example SDK snippets, 3) migration guidance, 4) known-issues bullets. Can folks claim bullets? Target: publish Wed 10:00 PT.

sarah: I can take the SDK snippets. Will open PR with examples for python/js tonight. PR: #4823. Tagging @maria for migration guide. :thumbsup:

maria: on it. I'll draft migration steps and a short checklist. Any breaking-change callouts? We should note that old cache keys need reindexing.

taylor: Flag: embeddings streaming is unchanged but there's a minor race that can surface when switching models mid-stream. Suggest a "Known issues" item with repro steps.

alex: Good catch. Can you write repro? 3-4 lines is fine. Put it under "Known issues" in the relnotes.

taylor: yep. repro:
```
1) start streaming call to model-a
2) send a second request with model-b
3) observe truncated final chunk ~30% cases
```
I'll paste this in a PR.

sarah: Snippet plan: python (redwood.Generate -> streaming), js (client.chat.stream). Will include preferred params: `batch_size: 8`, `use_kv_persistence: true`. Any wording preference for the blurb?

alex: Keep it concise. 2-paragraph blurb: what, why (performance/cost), upgrade notes (pin model versions + run reindex). I'll draft and push by EOD.

devex-bot: CI ✅ docs/lint passed on branch relnotes-adaptive-2026 — all links resolved.

maria: Migration checklist outline:
- backup existing cache
- run `rwd-cache reindex --from=kv-v1 --to=kv-v2`
- verify hit-rate via console > Observability > Caching
I'll add commands and expected timings.

docs-bot: Reminder: run `linkchecker --doc-root=site/public` before merging. Also add `<!-- relnote: 2026-03 -->` front-matter.

alex: Thanks all. Final ask: PRs in by 18:00 PT today. I'll collate into single relnotes draft and tag @product for sign-off at 20:00 PT.

maria: Acked. I'll also add a short example showing reindex progress JSON output.

sarah: One more: add a known-issue pointer for Dedicated autoscale delay on warm-up — metric names changed in this rollout. Small bullet.

alex: noted. This thread is the source of truth for the relnotes handoff. If you edit, comment on the PR rather than force-pushing. :pray:
